title: Am Samstag?
desc: An invitation with a date in it, and one without
setting: After the club, a car park, and somebody deciding how much to commit to.

steps.speaker: Timo
steps.en: We should eat together some time.

options.es: Gern. Hast du am Freitag Zeit?
options.en: Gladly. Are you free on Friday?
options.feedback: You turned mal into a date. That is the whole move, and it is the one nobody expects you to make.
Warm and it commits nobody. Mal has no date in it, so nothing will happen unless somebody adds one.
Fair question, and a slightly hard one. Naming a day yourself is easier for both of you.

steps.speaker: Timo
steps.es: Freitag geht nicht. Der Dienstag danach?
steps.en: Friday does not work. The Tuesday after?

options.feedback: Settled, and nobody will mention it again until Tuesday. That is what an arrangement is here.
Maybe is not an answer to a date. Say yes or say no and either one is fine.

options.es: Ich schaue noch. Ich sage dir Bescheid.
options.en: I will see. I will let you know.
options.feedback: Honest, and it puts the work on him. He got his calendar out of his bag for this.

steps.speaker: Timo
steps.es: Kommst du am Samstag ans Spiel?
steps.en: Are you coming to the match on Saturday?

options.es: Ja, gern. Um wie viel Uhr?
options.feedback: Yes and then the practical question. Both halves, in that order.

options.es: Ich habe leider schon etwas abgemacht.
options.en: Unfortunately I have already arranged something.
options.feedback: Leider, and no reason. Nobody asks what, and the reason stays yours.
It is Wednesday. By local arithmetic three days out is practically the day itself.

steps.speaker: Timo
steps.es: Also am Dienstag um halb acht.
steps.en: So Tuesday at half past seven.

options.es: Ich bin um zwanzig nach da.
options.en: I will be there at twenty past.
options.feedback: Five minutes early is on time. Saying so out loud is not fussy here, it is normal.
Done. He will be outside at twenty-five past and so, now, will you.
Half past seven is half past seven. Roughly is what the message four minutes beforehand is for.
